info.title: Yii3 Enterprise Platform API
info.description:
REST API v1. Stateless (Bearer tokens, no cookies). Success envelope: `{data, meta, links}`; errors: `{error: {code, message, details, correlation_id}}`.

See docs/API.md for auth flows, pagination, rate limits and the versioning policy.

post.description:
grant_type=password: username + password (+ mfa_code when the account has MFA). Login throttling and account lockout apply (429).

grant_type=client_credentials: client_id + client_secret of an API client (service account).
Returns a new pair and revokes the old one. Presenting an already-rotated refresh token revokes the whole token family (theft detection).

401.description: invalid_grant (unknown, expired, revoked or reused token)

post.summary: Revoke a token (and its whole family)

204.description: Revoked (also returned for unknown tokens, RFC 7009)

get.summary: Current principal: profile, roles, permissions and token scopes

get.description: Archived projects are excluded unless filter[status] includes "archived" or filter[include_archived]=1. q = full-text (code, name, description) + substring search.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: One of code, name, status, priority, budget, starts_on, due_on, created_at, updated_at; prefix "-" for descending. Default -created_at.

delete.summary: Archive a project (projects.delete). Allowed from draft or completed.
delete.description: With the workflow "project.lifecycle" enabled, archiving a completed project creates an approval request (approvals.decide, four-eyes) and returns 202 with meta.approval; the project is archived once approved.

patch.summary: Update a project (owner or projects.manage_all; If-Match or body version required)

post.summary: Lifecycle transition (draft→active needs projects.approve; →archived needs projects.delete)
Enqueue a CSV summary report for the caller tenant (background job)

post.description: When no password is given (and the policy allows passwords) a one-time temporary password is generated and returned once in meta.temporary_password.

patch.summary: Update a user (optimistic locking: If-Match or body version)

post.summary: Block a user (revokes sessions and tokens)

code.description:
Root OpenAPI 3.1 definitions for REST API v1 (info, security, shared schemas and responses).
Operations are documented with attributes on the action classes in src/Api/V1/Action.

name: Name must be between 2 and 200 characters.

password.description: Optional; a temporary password is generated when omitted

owner_id.description: Defaults to the caller; other owners need projects.manage_all

due_on.description: Must be on or after starts_on

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired Bearer token

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist or belongs to another tenant

Conflict.description: Stale version (stale_version) or forbidden state transition

ValidationFailed.description: Validation errors per field in error.details

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match / version is required for updates

If-Match.name: If-Match
If-Match.description: ETag (version) of the resource for optimistic locking, e.g. "3"

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/v1/auth/token (prefix yep_a_ / yep_p_).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Token issuance, refresh, revocation, current principal
